title: Albus Changes the World
author: Akihisa Maki
description:
The Demon Lord is defeated... and the world is at peace.

But... he didn't make it in time....... Albus the Hero is in a hurry.

The story starts over, and everything goes back, as it should, to where it all began. Time is of the essence in the repeating adventures of Albus the Hero, who remembers it all. Time is limited! Efficient strategy is key! When you recruit a priest to join your party, you have to be forceful! You don't want him to take things the wrong way. And before you know it, you'll be facing that dangerous S-class demon. Albus the Hero will finally claim his desired future in this ultra-fast real-time attack fantasy adventure!

Tags: Action, Comedy, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Tragedy, Time Travel, Magic
